```{r}
data <- data |>
  filter(!is.na(reported_mmi)) |>
  rename(
    felt_median = felt_mmi_median_cells
  )

mmi_counts <- data |>
  select(
    felt_mmi_1_reports,
    felt_mmi_2_reports,
    felt_mmi_3_reports,
    felt_mmi_4_reports,
    felt_mmi_5_reports,
    felt_mmi_6_reports,
    felt_mmi_7_reports,
    felt_mmi_8_reports
  ) |>
  as.matrix()

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    felt_mean =
      rowSums(mmi_counts * 1:8, na.rm = TRUE) /
      rowSums(mmi_counts, na.rm = TRUE),
    felt_mode = max.col(mmi_counts, ties.method = "first")
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(mt_Mw))
```

## checking the vs30 data
```{r}
vs30_data <- read_parquet("data_processed/vs30_site_lookup.parquet")
```

## mapping NZ
```{r}
unzip("statsnz-regional-council-2025-clipped-GPKG.zip", exdir = "nzmap")
```

```{r}
nzmap <- st_read("nzmap/regional-council-2025-clipped.gpkg")
```


```{r}
# Clean NZ map
nz_clean <- nzmap |>
  filter(REGC2025_V1_00_NAME != "Area Outside Region") |>
  st_make_valid()

# Combine NZ polygons and separate into individual polygons
nz_parts <- nz_clean |>
  summarise() |>
  st_geometry() |>
  st_cast("POLYGON")

# Find the two largest polygons = North Island + South Island
areas <- st_area(nz_parts)

mainland_parts <- nz_parts[
  order(areas, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]
]

# Combine North + South Islands
nz_mainland <- st_sf(
  geometry = st_union(mainland_parts),
  crs = st_crs(nzmap)
)

# Prepare Vs30 data
vs30_heat <- vs30_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Vs30_raw),
    is.finite(Vs30_raw),
    !is.na(vs30_cell_x),
    !is.na(vs30_cell_y)
  ) |>
  distinct(
    vs30_cell_x,
    vs30_cell_y,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

# Vs30 coordinates are originally longitude/latitude (WGS84)
vs30_heat_sf <- st_as_sf(
  vs30_heat,
  coords = c("vs30_cell_x", "vs30_cell_y"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Convert Vs30 points to the same NZGD2000 CRS as nzmap
vs30_heat_sf <- st_transform(
  vs30_heat_sf,
  st_crs(nzmap)
)

# Keep only Vs30 points within North + South Islands
vs30_heat_sf <- st_filter(
  vs30_heat_sf,
  nz_mainland,
  .predicate = st_within
)

# Get the transformed coordinates
coords <- st_coordinates(vs30_heat_sf)

vs30_heat_plot <- vs30_heat_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  mutate(
    x = coords[, 1],
    y = coords[, 2]
  )

```


```{r}
vs30_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = vs30_heat_plot,
    aes(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      fill = Vs30_raw
    ),
    width = 10000,
    height = 10000
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = nz_mainland,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Vs30 (m/s)",
    direction = -1
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    crs = st_crs(nzmap),
    default_crs = st_crs(nzmap),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Vs30 across New Zealand",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  )

vs30_map

ggsave(
  "vs30_map.png",
  plot = vs30_map,
  width = 20,
  height = 25,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
mmi_summary <- data_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        felt_mmi_1_reports,
        felt_mmi_2_reports,
        felt_mmi_3_reports,
        felt_mmi_4_reports,
        felt_mmi_5_reports,
        felt_mmi_6_reports,
        felt_mmi_7_reports,
        felt_mmi_8_reports
      ),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "mmi",
    values_to = "reports"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mmi = str_extract(mmi, "\\d+")
  )

ggplot(mmi_summary, aes(x = mmi, y = reports)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "MMI",
    y = "Number of Reports",
    title = "Felt Reports by MMI"
  ) 
```
```{r}
data_sf |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(
    across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "column",
    values_to = "na_count"
  ) |>
  filter(na_count > 0)
```

```{r}
dir.create("mmi_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

data_sf |>
  filter(!is.na(mt_Mw)) |>
  group_split(mt_Mw) |>
  purrr::walk(function(df) {

    mw <- unique(df$mt_Mw)

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Rhypo_km, y = reported_mmi)) +
      geom_jitter(
        height = 0.12,
        width = 0,
        alpha = 0.1
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2000)) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        breaks = 1:8,
        limits = c(1, 8)
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = "Hypocentral Distance (km)",
        y = "Reported MMI",
        title = paste("Reported MMI vs Hypocentral Distance — Mw", mw)
      )

    ggsave(
      filename = paste0("mmi_plots/Mw_", mw, ".png"),
      plot = p,
      width = 18,
      height = 12,
      units = "cm",
      dpi = 300
    )
  })
```

```{r}
felt_per_earthquake <- data |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  summarise(
    felt_reports = sum(
      felt_mmi_1_reports,
      felt_mmi_2_reports,
      felt_mmi_3_reports,
      felt_mmi_4_reports,
      felt_mmi_5_reports,
      felt_mmi_6_reports,
      felt_mmi_7_reports,
      felt_mmi_8_reports,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

ggplot(
  felt_per_earthquake,
  aes(x = reorder(publicid, felt_reports), y = felt_reports)
) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Earthquake",
    y = "Number of Felt Reports",
    title = "Felt Reports for Each Earthquake"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )
```
```{r}
felt_per_earthquake |>
```

```{r}
coords <- sf::st_coordinates(data_sf)

data_export <- data_sf |>
  mutate(
    longitude = coords[, 1],
    latitude = coords[, 2]
  ) |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry()

arrow::write_parquet(
  data_export,
  "data.parquet"
)
```
